Paul’s Snacks make the lunchboxes.
The lunchbox contains two sandwiches, one piece of fruit and one bottle of water.
The cost of making each lunchbox is $4.25 .
Each sandwich costs $1.45 and the bottle of water costs $0.70 .
Find the cost of the piece of fruit.
